purpose: One user-requested additional B attempt on the identical task with identical prepared context; not a replacement or best-of retry
modelSelection: Existing user CLI default at preparation time
tokenCapNote: CLI does not enforce a registered token cap; actual usage is recorded
isolation: Fresh containers and project copies; only own project and B-only read-only context mounted. Evaluator, research, reports and other methods are not mounted. Fresh CLI homes; memories, delegation, apps and web search disabled.
network: Provider access available; external solutions prohibited in task prompt. Shell egress is not technically restricted to provider domains.
evaluation: Fresh offline containers; no agent credentials; pristine upstream test files restored; all candidate changes and original logs retained
failurePolicy: One coding attempt, no manual repair or best-of selection; retain errors/timeouts and report them; do not overwrite original B
missingPreparationUsage: Coordinator token consumption and active human time unavailable; whole-workflow savings cannot be computed
inference: Descriptive B-to-B repetition only. No new A run and no general superiority or context-reuse causality claim
contextReuse: Same frozen pack bytes; fresh source checkout and conversation; no previous patch, logs, evaluator or research mounted
candidateTestValidation: Prespecified before this repetition: independently run all changed/new frontend test files against this candidate, in addition to the original registered gate
